notes: Employment demand uses SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census city-wide workplace total for Chennai (1,617,133 workers), redistributed across all 155 Chennai Corporation wards using each ward's share of real 2011 Census worker counts (Table PCA-TV). All 155 ward polygons matched a Census figure directly, so no modeled proxy weighting was needed anywhere. Jobs are placed within each ward onto OSM building footprints, split by type using standard land-use assumptions. Population and commute data follow the standard pipeline used across this project's India maps.
